name: Night of the Dancing Flowers
source:
You are the night clerk at a very unpopular love motel, and tonight [b]should[/b] be just like any other night.

The evening clerk is being fired as you arrive for work because she put one of those dancing flowers on the reception desk.  She seems to have left it behind in the break room when she left...

...or did she?

There seem to be more of them than there really ought to be...

[From [url=https://pyrrhaiphis.itch.io/night-of-the-dancing-flowers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一家非常不受欢迎的爱情汽车旅馆的夜班服务员，今晚[b]应该[/b]就像任何其他夜晚一样。

当你上班时，夜班服务员被解雇了，因为她把一朵跳舞的花放在接待台上。她离开时似乎把它落在休息室里了……

…或者她是吗？

他们的数量似乎比实际应该有的还要多……

[来自[url=https://pyrrhaiphis.itch.io/night-of-the-dancing-flowers]Itch.io[/url]]
